title: A malformed ticker with special characters (a script tag, '$$%^') that makes yfinance return a non-JSON body is still classified provider_error/502/"Retry" instead of not_found -- same recurring misclassification the round-3 verifier already flagged (rc1-verifier:7) against this fixed entry, still unfixed on the round-4 candidate
repro: curl 'http://127.0.0.1:52327/quotes/%3Cscript%3Ealert%281%29%3C%2Fscript%3E' -> HTTP 502 {"detail":"The data provider returned an unexpected response.","code":"provider_error","action":"Retry, or try again later."}; sidecar log: 'yfinance quote failed for ...: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' (Yahoo returned an empty/non-JSON body for this deterministically-invalid symbol). Repeated with the round-3 verifier's exact repro 'curl http://127.0.0.1:52327/quotes/%24%24%25%5E' -> identical 502 provider_error/Retry body. The 'Retry' action is actively wrong: this symbol will 502 identically every time, it is not a transient upstream fault. A plain malformed symbol without special characters ($$$, 300-char string, unicode, RELIANCE.NS.NS, a SQL-injection string) all correctly 404 not_found on the same candidate -- only the subset that makes yfinance return a non-JSON/empty body (rather than its usual 'no data found' JSON error) falls into the still-unfixed 502 path.

title: An unknown-but-plausible symbol's /fundamentals/{sym}/income, /balance and /ratings answer 200 with empty/null data and no reason field, indistinguishable from a real company that legitimately has zero filings -- same recurring class the round-3 verifier flagged against this fixed entry, still unfixed on the round-4 candidate
repro: GET /fundamentals/ZZZZNOTREAL/income -> 200 {"symbol":"ZZZZNOTREAL.NS","periods":[],"lines":[],"provider":"yfinance","gaps":[]}; /balance -> same shape, empty; /ratings -> 200 {"consensus":null,...,"strong_buy":0,...}. No field anywhere states the symbol itself was not found -- 'gaps' is an empty array, not a reason. Contrast GET /quotes/ZZZZNOTREAL on the same sidecar, which correctly 404s not_found with 'check the symbol'. A user or agent reading only the fundamentals/ratings routes for a mistyped symbol sees clean zero-value data, not an error.
